description:
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast a copy of Seething Song by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Choreographed Sparks by paying {R}{R}, copying the Seething Song and Vampire Charmseeker spells.
Resolve the copy of the Vampire Charmseeker spell. When the token copy enters, it triggers, returning Choreographed Sparks from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of the Seething Song spell, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
